requirement: v3.5.0: version governance (minimum supported plugin version gate with named refusal and an allowOutdated override, plus the read-only fleet version dashboard), backup retention by count and age, offsite mirror with real-path containment and corrupt-object repair, account-id compare-only unlock, three protection states (unencrypted default / account-id convenience / 4-6 digit PIN), old-format full copies with backfill, and the Relay Phase 2 merge review.

assertions.version_gate: a dispatch whose online targets include a machine below MIN_SUPPORTED_PLUGIN_VERSION is refused with MACHINE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED naming every machine/version/minimum; allowOutdated:true proceeds with an audit record; read-only tools are never refused; the dashboard renders the distribution/outdated/unknown/all_current block
assertions.retention: keep-N and max-age rules apply together; a referenced record is never pruned; full copies are pruned with their records and orphan copies are collected
assertions.mirror: only missing sealed objects are copied; truncated/corrupt copies are repaired; a junction escaping into the repo or DSH_HOME is refused with BACKUP_MIRROR_SYMLINK; a mirror failure never rolls back the committed backup
assertions.protection: new repositories default to unencrypted (open envelope) and open without a credential; adding a password/PIN or account binding removes the open envelope and flips to sealed; 4-6 digit PINs are accepted with a weak-password warning; account-id compare unlocks only on a match and otherwise falls back to the password path
assertions.old_format: old-format full writes a sealed whole-file copy next to each record; old-backfill migrates records created before the mode existed and is idempotent
assertions.phase2: the Relay Phase 2 branch was reviewed (merge-with-conditions) and is not merged
